name: Food chain Magnate

categories.label: Cash at end of game
categories.hint: Count your cash after finishing the phase in which the bank breaks the 2nd time (include income owed by the bank).

tiebreakers.description: Tied player earlier in turn order wins

endCondition.description: Game ends when the bank breaks for the second time; finish that restaurant-income phase (owed income is noted on paper, no salaries paid that turn)

notes: family: money-count (richest player wins, no VP). Introductory variant ends when the bank breaks once. Milestones, employees etc. have no end-game points.

sources.title: Food Chain Magnate rulebook (Splotter Spellen)
sources.section: Overview (richest player wins); Phase 4 'Breaking the bank (2nd time)'
